# Portrait regression fixture

`0000-portrait-umireon.jpg` is the input image. The alpha channel of
`0000-portrait-umireon-cutout.png` is the visually accepted foreground mask,
generated by the current DirectML model at threshold 0.42 and 1280 × 720.
Both images are by Kaito Udagawa and licensed under CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0.

`GpuImageInferenceTest.PortraitFixture` runs the complete generated mask graph,
using WIC linear RGB resizing to 256 × 144 and normalization to [0, 1].
It linearly upsamples the background mask and uses <= 0.5 as foreground.
It requires foreground IoU >= 0.995 and full-frame pixel disagreement <= 0.002.
These bounds permit small boundary changes while limiting foreground-union
drift to 0.5% and frame-wide drift to 0.2%.

This is an approved-output regression check, not independently annotated ground
truth or a dataset-wide quality measurement. Tests only read the fixture;
changing the reference requires visual review. WinML is not used by this test.
